title: SQL Connection - Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
author: NeviZz
body_snippet:
Hi,

I would like to report an issue with retrieving configurations from the database. Currently, regardless of which computer we use, we encounter the same error.

To rule out a compatibility issue between different software versions and the existing database, I even created a brand-new database. However, the problem persists, which suggests that the database itself is not the root cause.

Logs from Portable version, but the same is on the "normal" version.

iterations.description: Same DoesDbTableExist query (information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = <database name>) exists in the fork, but two guards defuse it: the #1784 direct 'select 1 from <table> where 1=0' fallback finds the tables anyway, and SqlConnectionsLoader.Load() null-coalesces missing metadata into HandleFirstRun, so no NRE and no schema wipe. Query is still semantically wrong on MSSQL/PostgreSQL (schema != catalog) and costs one extra round-trip per table; candidate cleanup: match table_catalog OR table_schema.

comments.author: eran132
comments.snippet:
I reproduced this against SQL Server 2022 and tracked down the cause — the crash is a side effect of something worse.

`DoesDbTableExist` queries `information_schema.tables` with `table_schema = <database name>`. On SQL Server `TABLE_SCHEMA` is the schema (`dbo`); the database name is `TABLE_CATALOG`. So the check never matches, `GetDatabaseMetaData` concludes the tables are missing, and `InitializeDatabaseSchema` runs on **every load** — dropping and recreating `tblCons`, `tblRoot` and `tblUpda...

notes: eran132 diagnosed upstream root cause (TABLE_SCHEMA vs TABLE_CATALOG). Fork mitigated, not fixed. Triaged 2026-09-22.
